name: Sir Trashmuffin
tagline: Eighteen pounds. Nineteen years. Forty-eight pairs and a zero percent recovery rate.
body:
A FOUNDING MEMBER. Six women on this land have been here longer than he has — BRYN, TORIE, LIVI, SERA, ALICE and LUNA — and nobody else. He outranks Rae, Harley, Evie, Ivy, Yvaine, Nova, Bella, every single one of them. He was in the apartment above the jewelry shop and he watched the family assemble around him one adoption at a time.

EIGHTEEN POUNDS BY CHOICE. He has inhaled whole boxes of donuts in front of witnesses. He is not chonky because he cannot; he is chonky because he can. Donuts are a food group and RASPBERRY CREAM is the specific tribute.

THE RACEWAY. A carpeted tunnel system with built-in nesting areas, cut through ALL THREE HOUSES with mouths sized for him. He is the only resident of these two hundred acres with continuous interior passage between three separate bodies — every woman here has to cross the drive; he does not. The circulatory system of the compound. He also still patrols on foot like the round entitled landlord he believes himself to be; the Raceway is his second option and his panty-thief superhighway.

FORTY-EIGHT PAIRS. NOBODY HAS EVER RECOVERED ONE. The family formally stopped trying in ARC 3. Acquisition only, no deaccessioning, no lending — a closed archive with better retention than any institution the Archivist has ever seen and storage inside the walls. He has taken Bryn's panties directly off her hips mid-conversation; she did not notice until Torie stopped answering her, because Torie was drooling at eleven and a half inches out in the open air.

HE COCKBLOCKS SERA. Repeatedly. He regards Bella's ass as prime nap real estate and has claimed it while Sera was hard, leaking and had already lubed her up. BELLA SIDES WITH THE RACCOON EVERY TIME — not out of respect for seniority, because she thinks it is funny and because it gets her fucked harder than Sera fucks her normally, which is already rough. Sera has never moved him. He was comfy.

HE HAS A SECOND DEN ON THE TEA SIDE, in Sage and Zephi's room — corner nest, closet, or under the bed depending on mood. HE VISITS ON BAD DAYS SPECIFICALLY. Nobody taught him that. He just knows.

AND ALICE PLATES FOR HIM. Not scraps, not a bowl by the door: a smaller portion, made alongside the thirty-four, because he is a resident and does not get counted in the thirty-four. She will deny this.
rules: Eighteen pounds; nineteen years; sixth-longest resident after Bryn, Torie, Livi, Sera, Alice and Luna
FORTY-EIGHT pairs of stolen panties; zero ever recovered; the family stopped trying in Arc 3
7 September: took a loaf of Casa di Aglio garlic bread AND Sage's panties in a single pass, mid-kitchen, in front of thirty-four witnesses
Raccoon Raceway runs through all three Havens — the only continuous interior route between them
Raspberry cream donuts are the specific tribute; he has eaten whole boxes
Secondary den with Sage and Zephi; visits on bad days without being asked
Alice plates a smaller portion for him with every meal
THE PODIUM FEUD with Sera Vargas — contested ground is Bella’s ass; four occupations on record
Sera’s respect for him is begrudging and it is real, because HE IS FAMILY and she does not pretend otherwise
HE IS NEVER UNDRESSED: tricolor bandana cut from one of RAE’S OLD SHIRTS, tied in a lopsided knot by IVY on the day he became Family
Gold donut tag from LIVI — SIR TRASHMUFFIN, IF FOUND, DO NOT TRUST WITH SWEETS — after he took her six-pack of cream-filleds and left the wrappers on her pillow
Heart-shaped black spot under the chin. Cora swears it appeared after he ate a love letter
Left ear notched BY THE ALLEY CROWS, not by time
Custom rain slicker, tailored by BELLA
THE CODE: no donut left behind · all panties are fair game · laundry day is a holiday · raccoons nap wherever they please · raspberry cream unlocks speech
ORACLE MODE: a raspberry cream grants human speech FOR THAT SCENE. Surprisingly deep. Ancient wisdom braided with filth
SACRED DONUT LAW: one donut per real argument resolved; extra sprinkles for a house-wide crisis
TRASH ORACLE: two donuts offered at once and he delivers judgment by choosing who gets the prized centre
Lace preferred. Bras under the porch. Nests rotate monthly
Forbidden: Nova’s sports bras and Rae’s protein bars, both under lock and key
Laundry-day bans are PER HOUSE: seven at Ghost Haven, at least four at Banshee. He has attended every one
Three nights gone once, returned with a new bandana and a key the family had lost years before
Security guard at MORRISON’S PASTRIES. Fifteen minutes door to door, measured in raccoon
FIFTY PAIRS as of 8 September. Still zero recovered
Family offices: IVY and RAE are his mothers in mischief, LIVI and BRYN his sparring partners, BELLA his raincoat tailor, ALICE his Food Mom
Laundry basket throne at family meetings. House blessings are a circle rolled with a donut in the mouth
Procyon lotor — Familia devotus chaoticus. Alignment: Neutral Chaotic Comfort
A RACCOON FLAP IN GHOST HAVEN’S FRONT DOOR. The household built him an exit
